wanter_cz: The old hands of R-F19 have been here since Day 1. Clement Wanter has been here since Day 3. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.
Hugo Serreno and Clement Wanter argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war.
Dawn watch. Clement Wanter put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Jakub Nistico, grazed.
Clement Wanter tried to dry a page near the stove. The paper survived, but the message now has the smell of toasted bread.
